title: Add Agent, MCP and Chatbot to otel-demo
author: fali007
body:
# Changes

Add Agent, MCP and ChatBot to Otel Demo application.
1. Agent - Langgraph ReAct agent which can accept user requests then with the help of LLM call, it identifies the right set of tools. Agent also has an LLM response caching feature.
2. MCP - Agent can be configured to use MCP tools or native langgraph tools to interact with demo application.
3. Chatbot facilitates an interactive UI for users to send requests to agent.

### Testing the PR
1. `make build` - build agent, mcp, chatbot and frontend-proxy components.
2. `make start` - This should start otel-demo along with 3 new services
3. Default requests in chatbot ui have cached llm responses available. To try out other requests please configure `LLM_API_KEY` and `LLM_BASE_URL`. 

This is a Draft PR to demo changes to address #3140 
It is a follow up of Draft PR: #3148 
## Merge Requirements

For new features contributions, please make sure you have completed the following
essential items:

* [x] `CHANGELOG.md` updated to document new feature additions
